chapter: Later views and life in Dallas
title: Avoiding the draft through the USO
summary: Smith was deferred because he entertained soldiers in the USO.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: How did you get out of being drafted into the Army?

I was in USO. That's what saved me. I had to register, but they deferred me, and they wouldn't take me in the Army because I was playing to entertain the soldiers. That was the purpose to get in the USO...
To get out of the Army.

Yeah. I didn't have to go. So we just went across and entertained soldiers all across the country there. So they just put me back in (?). Then they changed the age... When they changed the age, they missed me about a year.
